row: | ultra_processed | Ultra-processed & processed food | Processed and ultra-processed foods, fast food and junk food as a health subject, the NOVA classification, food engineering and hyperpalatability. | ultra-processed food; highly processed food; processed junk; junk food; fast food; NOVA classification; bliss point; hyperpalatable; "edible food-like substances" |

| fats_oils | Fats & cooking oils | Dietary fats and oils: seed and vegetable oils, saturated fat, trans fat, dietary cholesterol, butter, tallow, olive oil, frying, the omega-6 to omega-3 balance in food, and low-fat diets and the low-fat era. | meat_animal_foods | Meat, eggs, fish & meat substitutes | Meat, poultry, eggs, fish, organ meats and bone broth as foods and their health effects, and foods offered in place of meat: plant-based meat substitutes, lab-grown meat and insects as food. | dairy_raw_milk | Dairy & raw milk | Milk and dairy products as food, including raw (unpasteurized) milk, whole and full-fat dairy, and cutting out dairy. | protein_intake | Protein intake | How much protein people need and where they get it from food, including high-protein diets and protein bars. | plant_foods_fiber | Fruits, vegetables, fiber & plant compounds | Produce, legumes, nuts and seeds, fiber, soy as food, and plant compounds eaten in food that are said to help or harm. | additives_dyes | Additives, dyes & preservatives | Specific food additives, including their regulation and bans and the GRAS process for food. | organic_gmo | Organic, GMO & farming practices | How food is produced as a health question: organic versus conventional, GMOs, regenerative agriculture, soil quality, and how livestock are raised (pasture, antibiotics, hormones). Pesticide residue in food goes to `food.food_contaminants`; antibiotic resistance to `infectious.antibiotics_resistance`. | organic; GMO; regenerative farming; soil depletion; grass-fed vs grain-fed; pasture-raised; raised without antibiotics; no added hormones; bioengineered |

| beverages_hydration | Water, hydration & beverages | Drinking water as hydration, ready-to-drink sports and electrolyte drinks, soda, juice, and "wellness waters". | micronutrients_food | Vitamins & minerals from food | Vitamins and minerals from named food sources, nutrient density, the bioavailability of nutrients in food, and deficiency diseases explained through diet. Nutrient status (levels, deficiency, testing, "you need more X") with no form stated goes to the nutrient's `supplements` subtopic, as does the bioavailability of a supplement form; dietary salt goes to `food.salt_sodium`. | vitamin C in fruit; scurvy; iron-rich foods; heme iron; nutrient-dense foods; the most nutrient-dense food |

| salt_sodium | Salt & sodium intake | Dietary salt and sodium: how much to eat, low-salt and low-sodium diets, kinds of salt (sea, Celtic, unrefined) and salting food or water. Salt's effect on blood pressure also takes `cardiovascular.blood_pressure`; electrolyte powders and salt tablets go to `supplements.other_vitamins_minerals`; salt named only in the "salt, sugar and fat" of processed food goes to `food.ultra_processed`. | salt intake; too much salt; low-sodium diet; salt and blood pressure; Celtic salt; unrefined sea salt; salt your food; salt in your water |

| eating_behavior | Eating behavior, appetite & cravings | When and how people eat: meal timing, breakfast, late-night eating, snacking, overeating, cravings, hunger and satiety signals, food addiction, mindful or intuitive eating. | food_system_access | Food system, access & school food | The food system and access to food as health issues: school meals, food deserts, food assistance and what it may buy, food prices, agriculture policy, the food industry's structure. | school lunch; SNAP soda restrictions; food stamps; food deserts; food insecurity; food banks; farm subsidies |

| general_nutrition | General nutrition & healthy eating | Healthy eating, "real food", balanced diet, food as medicine, the standard American diet, macronutrient balance in general, and official dietary advice as a whole (the food pyramid, MyPlate, the dietary guidelines), with no specific food, nutrient or named diet. | low_carb_keto | Low-carb & ketogenic | Low-carbohydrate and ketogenic diets, carb cycling, and ketosis from eating. Exogenous ketone products go to `supplements.other_compounds`. | keto; ketosis; low-carb; Atkins; carb cycling; ketones from diet |

| plant_based | Vegan, vegetarian & plant-based | Diets excluding or minimizing animal foods, including pescatarian diets and low-fat plant-based programmes. | fasting | Fasting & time-restricted eating | Intermittent, extended and water fasting, time-restricted eating, fasting-mimicking diets, one meal a day, and religious fasting when its health effects are discussed. | ancestral_paleo | Paleo, ancestral & traditional diets | Diets defined by an ancestral or traditional ideal. | paleo; pegan; ancestral diet; nose-to-tail eating; Weston A. Price; traditional foods; "eat like your great-grandmother" |

| mediterranean_whole_food | Mediterranean & whole-food patterns | Mediterranean, DASH, MIND, Blue Zones and named "whole foods" or anti-inflammatory eating patterns followed as a general way of eating. | raw_food_juicing | Raw-food & juicing diets | Diets built on raw foods or juices as an ongoing way of eating, and the "living food" ideas behind them.
